title: phoneticName storage location (character vs persona)
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:63-64 '// phoneticName lives as a top-level character/persona column (not in extensions): phoneticName: string, // ... edited in the Voice tab (v2.5.0)'; :128 'phoneticName (top-level column, phonetic_name; part of the card...)'
reality: For CHARACTERS it is data.extensions.phoneticName: CharacterEditor.tsx:5572/5600 reads/writes formData.extensions.phoneticName via updateExtension; macro-context.ts:250/730 read data.extensions?.phoneticName; types/character.ts:79 declares it on CharacterExtensions; the characters table (db/schema/characters.ts:6-18) has no phonetic_name column. Only PERSONAS have the phonetic_name column (db/schema/characters.ts:58, persona.schema.ts:277), and personas edit it on the persona Metadata tab (PersonaEditor.tsx:3662; docs/characters/personas.md Metadata tab) - the Persona editor has no Voice tab (docs/characters/personas.md tab list). docs/prompts/macros.md:70 says the field is in both editors.
fix: character-cards.md schema block: move phoneticName into extensions ('phoneticName: string, // TTS pronunciation; Voice tab (v2.5.0)') and replace the 'top-level character/persona column' comment with 'characters: extensions.phoneticName; personas: phonetic_name persona column, on the persona Metadata tab (personas have no Voice tab)'. Fix :128 the same way. Optionally add extensions.phoneticName: '' to the template.

title: rpgStats.pools missing from schema and template
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:45-49 'rpgStats: { enabled, attributes: {name,value}[], hp: { value, max } }'; assets/character-card.template.json:36-40 'rpgStats': {enabled:false, attributes:[], hp:{value:0,max:0}}
reality: docs/characters/colors-and-stats.md:47-50: Enable RPG Stats shows Pools (named bars with value, max and color; new cards start with HP and MP at 100/100) and Attributes (STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA at 10). Code: types/character.ts:124-140 RPGStatsConfig has pools?: RPGStatPool[] {name,value,max,color}; rpg-stats.ts:3-6 DEFAULT_RPG_STAT_POOLS HP #ef4444 / MP #3b82f6; normalizeRpgStatPools (rpg-stats.ts:32-44) prefers pools and only falls back to a single HP pool built from hp, clamping max to >=1 - so the template's hp {0,0} becomes HP 0/1 if a user flips enabled on; syncRpgHpFromPools keeps hp mirrored from the HP pool. Pools are what the prompt prints (formatRpgStatsForPrompt) and what Character Tracker adjusts.
fix: Schema block: add 'pools: { name: string, value: number, max: number, color: string }[], // HP/MP-style bars (default HP + MP 100/100); hp is the legacy mirror of the HP pool'. Template: add "pools": [{"name":"HP","value":100,"max":100,"color":"#ef4444"},{"name":"MP","value":100,"max":100,"color":"#3b82f6"}] and set hp to {value:100,max:100}. Cite docs/characters/colors-and-stats.md.

title: Persona data shape differs from cards (stats, profile, ruleset sheets)
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:116 'These fields live on the character/persona extensions schema ... Characters and personas carry the same profile columns'; :344 'Characters and personas can hold a starting build ... Stored in extensions.rulesetSheets'; persona Stats / Status Bars absent
reality: Personas have no extensions object: their fields are top-level persona columns (persona.schema.ts:270-297). Persona stats live in personaStats {enabled, bars[], rpgStats, rulesetSheets} (persona.schema.ts:251-260) - so a persona's ruleset sheets are personaStats.rulesetSheets, not extensions.rulesetSheets. The persona Stats tab has two blocks: Persona Status Bars (Enable Persona Stats; starter Satiety, Energy, Hygiene, Mood at 100/100, adjusted by the Persona Stats agent) and RPG Attributes (Enable RPG Attributes; HP/MP pools + six attributes, not agent-managed) (docs/characters/colors-and-stats.md:52-58,81-89; docs/characters/personas.md:117-126; en.json ui.personas.personastatstab.*). The persona Convo tab has no 'Declare this name on the card in the prompt' checkbox - that toggle is characters-only (docs/conversation/profiles.md:20; persona.schema.ts persona fields lack convoDisplayNameInCard).
fix: Add a short 'Persona fields' note under Character vs. Persona: persona fields are top-level columns (no extensions); stats in personaStats {enabled, bars (Persona Status Bars, Persona Stats agent), rpgStats, rulesetSheets}; convoDisplayNameInCard is characters-only. At :116 say 'character extensions / persona columns'. At :344 say 'characters: extensions.rulesetSheets; personas: personaStats.rulesetSheets'. Cite docs/characters/colors-and-stats.md.

title: Sprites: full-body category, display requirements, tooling
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:352 'Characters can have expression sprites for VN-style overlays in roleplay mode ... The Expression Engine agent picks the matching sprite per message. There's also an automated sprite generation feature ... introduced in recent versions'; :360 says sprites.md covers production but gives none of it
reality: docs/characters/sprites.md: the Sprites tab (characters AND personas) has Facial Expressions, Full-body (poses; stored with a full_ prefix, sprite-labels.ts:24) and Clips. Sprites show only in Roleplay and Game Mode, never Conversation. Game Mode shows the speaker's full-body sprite automatically, no Expression Engine needed. In Roleplay, sprites appear only when the downloadable Expression Engine agent (Agents -> Download Agents) is enabled for the chat, a character or the persona is chosen as sprite owner, and a Sprite Source (Expressions / Full-body, both on by default) is on; Expression Avatars (off by default, Roleplay only) swaps the message avatar instead of an overlay; Arrange / Default Side / size 5-200% and opacity 15-100% sliders. Tooling: Quick add, Upload Folder (filename = sprite name), Generate Sprite (up to four reference images, Transparent sprite background, Match existing expression sprites for full-body, Generate animated portraits), Clean Backgrounds with Cleanup strength 0-100 (default 35) and Undo Cleanup, Export zip (Expressions only / Full-body only / All sprites). Labels verified in en.json (ui.characters.spritestab.*, ui.chat.expressionsetupfields.expressionAvatars, ui.chat.spritedisplaymodetoggle.spriteSource, ui.ui.spritegenerationmodal.*).
fix: Rewrite the Sprite System opener in 4-6 lines: two kinds (Facial Expressions, Full-body) + Clips; personas have sprites too; where they show (RP via downloadable Expression Engine + sprite owner + sprite source; Game Mode full-body automatic; never Conversation); Expression Avatars; the production tools listed above. Replace 'introduced in recent versions' with the Generate Sprite window. Cite docs/characters/sprites.md.
